properties.description: The controls, in order; `{ type: "separator" }` draws a divider

properties.name: pressed
properties.description: The ids of the toggles that are on, for the text that's selected

properties.name: values
properties.description: Each menu's chosen option, by the menu's id; a menu without one shows its own icon

properties.name: anchor
properties.description: What it floats over: a rectangle in viewport pixels (`selectionRect()`) or an element. Without one it sits in the page's flow

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the floating bar shows; it sets itself false when it closes itself. No effect without an `anchor`

properties.name: editor
properties.description: The editor it formats: a click there doesn't close the bar, and Escape puts focus back in it

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-command
events.description: A control was used: a button ({ id }), a toggle ({ id, value: on }) or a menu option ({ id, value }) (SelectionToolbarCommand)

events.name: tc-pressed-change
events.description: A toggle was pressed ({ pressed, id }: SelectionToolbarPressedChange); cancelable – prevented, `pressed` stays as it was

events.name: tc-values-change
events.description: A menu option was chosen ({ values, id, value }: SelectionToolbarValuesChange); cancelable – prevented, `values` stays as it was

events.name: tc-close
events.description: The floating bar closed itself – Escape, or a click outside it and the editor ({ reason }: SelectionToolbarClose)

methods.name: focusToolbar
methods.description: Moves focus to the bar's current control – for the editor's "go to toolbar" key (Alt + F10 is usual)

functions.name: defaultSelectionToolbarItems
functions.description: The bar in the reference layout: ask, comment and react; text style; bold to code; colour; list type; link

functions.name: selectionRect
functions.description: The current selection's box in viewport pixels – an `anchor` for the bar – or null when nothing is selected

props.name: pressed
props.description: The toggles that are on – controlled when given (usually from the editor's state at the selection)

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: The toggles on at first, when `pressed` isn't controlled

props.name: values
props.description: Each menu's chosen option – controlled when given

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: The menus' options at first, when `values` isn't controlled

props.name: onValuesChange
props.type: (values: Record<string, string>, id: string, value: string) => void

changelog: **Selection Toolbar** (`tc-selection-toolbar`): the formatting bar that floats over selected text – quick actions, toggles that show what's on, menus for text style, colour and list type, and a link. It fires `tc-command` for the page's editor to apply; `selectionRect()` gives it an anchor, and `focusToolbar()` is for the editor's Alt + F10.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
